meta.title: Katalog ekstrakurikuler

review.rule: D-113: nothing here is imported or seeded before Tim Validasi SIGRAK signs it off.

decisions.D-210: Ekstrakurikuler with Pramuka or another kepanduan is offered (Permendikdasmen 13/2025 Pasal 22).
decisions.D-216: Ekstrakurikuler records (activities, pembina, members, attendance, rapor description) are built early in v1, with Pramuka offered by default.
decisions.D-305: Catalog copied from usulan-01 for one Tim Validasi review.
decisions.D-367: Curated with SIGRAK names, keys, and codes.
decisions.D-452: Pramuka is set up by default; a school may replace it with another kepanduan, but one must stay (Permendikdasmen 13/2025 Pasal 22 ayat (2)). KKA is an optional subject in grades 5–6 that a school runs as a regular subject or through kokurikuler; it is not an ekstrakurikuler. Supersedes D-208.

conventions: Keys are English snake_case and never change once seeded; labels and other text shown to users are Indonesian.

Codes follow SIGRAK-KAT-<AREA>-NN for the main items of a file and SIGRAK-KAT-<AREA>-<LIST>-NN for its secondary lists (see README.md). Codes are stable: a retired item keeps its code, and new items take the next free number.
No identifier from the legacy app is carried over. Where a decision keeps an old label for reference (D-305), it sits in legacy_label and is never shown in the UI.
review_notes are Indonesian notes for Tim Validasi SIGRAK; they are not shown to teachers.
items are the ekstrakurikuler a school can switch on; each belongs to one category. A school may add its own items.
mandatory_to_offer = true would mean the item alone can never be removed from the school's list; no item uses it now (D-452). offered_by_default = true means it is switched on for a new school.

offer_groups are minimum-offer rules over several items: at least min items whose offer_group equals the group key must stay switched on, and default names the item switched on for a new school. A school-added item joins a group by carrying its offer_group. Group scouting: Pramuka by default, replaceable by another kepanduan, one must stay (Permendikdasmen 13/2025 Pasal 22 ayat (2); D-452).
formats lists the usual ways a category runs: group (Kelompok), individual (Individual), classical (Klasikal), in the source's order.
days use ISO weekday numbers (1 = Monday); ekstrakurikuler may run on Saturday or Sunday, unlike timetable_slots (weekday 1–6).

categories.label: Kepramukaan dan Kepemimpinan
categories.purpose: Wahana murid berlatih berorganisasi, terampil dan mandiri, memiliki jiwa sosial, bekerja sama, dan menyelesaikan permasalahan.

categories.label: Olahraga
categories.purpose: Mengembangkan kebugaran, sportivitas, disiplin, kerja sama, serta bakat murid dalam bidang olahraga.

categories.label: Seni dan Budaya
categories.purpose: Mengembangkan apresiasi, kreativitas, ekspresi, dan keterampilan murid dalam bidang seni dan budaya.

categories.label: Bela Diri
categories.purpose: Melatih kebugaran, disiplin, pengendalian diri, keberanian, dan sportivitas murid.

categories.label: Kesehatan
categories.purpose: Mengembangkan kepedulian, keterampilan hidup sehat, kesiapsiagaan, dan kemampuan menolong sesama.

categories.label: Teknologi dan Sains
categories.purpose: Mengembangkan rasa ingin tahu, penalaran, kreativitas, serta keterampilan murid dalam teknologi dan sains.

offer_groups.label: Kepramukaan atau kepanduan lainnya
review_notes: Sekolah wajib menyediakan paling sedikit satu ekstrakurikuler kepramukaan atau kepanduan lain. Pramuka menyala sejak awal; sekolah boleh menggantinya dengan kepanduan lain yang ditambahkan dengan offer_group scouting, asal satu tetap menyala.

items.label: Pramuka
review_notes: Pilihan bawaan kelompok kepanduan (offer_groups scouting, paling sedikit 1; Permendikdasmen 13/2025 Pasal 22 ayat (2); D-210, D-216, D-452). Sekolah boleh mengganti Pramuka dengan kepanduan lain, asal satu kepanduan tetap disediakan.

items.label: Koding
review_notes: Bedakan dari mata pelajaran pilihan Koding dan Kecerdasan Artifisial (KKA) kelas 5–6, yang dijalankan sekolah sebagai mapel atau lewat kokurikuler (D-452). Ekstrakurikuler koding adalah salah satu pilihan dalam Kepmendikdasmen 127/P/2025 BAB II huruf B angka 4.
